description: Twelve actual Portuguese- and English-language open-web queries covered four March date windows, national/cross-island issues, education, health, municipal workers, public administration, tourism/hotel workers, fishing/agriculture and local media. Searches returned multiple later/earlier false leads but no supported March 2023 candidate. Coverage remains uneven across islands and source archives; the pass is bounded rather than exhaustive.
required_followup: For any additional pass, search accessible local/union/municipal archives and distinct reporting for Boa Vista, Sal, Fogo, Maio, Santo Antão, São Nicolau and Brava, with exact March dates; do not infer absence from these results.
